title: The second lock on the door
text: The humble password has {{1}} the weakest link in digital security. Billions of login details {{2}} leaked over the years, and many people, {{3}} reuse a favourite phrase across dozens of sites, hand attackers a master key {{4}} their entire digital life. A single password {{5}} therefore no longer enough. {{6}} is far harder to steal a fresh code that expires in thirty seconds than a memorised word, {{7}} is why most serious services now ask for a second factor. However, the commonest one — a code texted to your phone — is the easiest to intercept, so {{8}} possible, security specialists recommend an authenticator app or a hardware key instead.
